summary: Backend-only CI/helper validation completed for TV CDN automation scope. Workflow schema lint (via github-actionlint wrapper), Python stdlib unittest history suite, Node node:test suites, and local build+verify+Wrangler dry-run all passed without publication.

History fail-closed behavior is enforced by tests: no fallback on corrupted newest checkpoint, strict archive safety checks before destination mutation, and release selection by max release ID among tv-cdn-* releases with both assets.
